description: Manchester City Council publishes the locations of the street lighting it owns and manages as a downloadable register. The data.gov.uk record read on 2026-09-29, last updated on 17 November 2025, offers XLSX and CSV files, free to download under a Creative Commons Attribution licence, and lists the council's open data team as contact. Coverage is one city at lighting unit level for a single snapshot, and no update schedule is stated. Caveats: the page shows no field list or counts, the register holds locations and types, not energy use or condition, and the record notes the Open Government Licence framework alongside the Creative Commons text, so the licence version should be confirmed before reuse. It suits capacity planning for lighting upgrades and energy studies, exposure of street furniture to hazards and city digital twin layers. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
